fail_closed_rules: Sold Post and Sold Prior without consideration are not assigned prices.
Withdrawn Prior and Withdrawn Post are not represented as completed sales or current availability.
Unreadable official update endpoints are not reconstructed or guessed.
Informally reduced payments are not substituted for documented contractual rent.
Tenant options, mutual breaks, holding-over occupation and future fixed or RPI-linked rents are not silently resolved.
Peppercorn and percentage head rents are not confused with occupational income.
Planning and development potential are not represented as implemented, consented or valued outcomes.
Seller legal fees, deposits and administration charges remain separate from sale price and rent.
Active company status and registered charges do not imply covenant strength, occupation or property-level lease performance.
Legal-pack EPC, update, title and tenancy details are not filled by inference.
No business or parcel row was written by the maintenance/control slot.
